description: Shows the menu of Collager.ai photo collages with a real example: the shapes make_shape_collage can draw (hearts of 27-164 photos, numbers, words, I love you, circle, star, flower, grid, your own mask) and how many photos fill each without repeats. Call it first when the user only mentions Collager.ai, says hello to it, or asks what it can make.
